newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sweden's IFS Industrial opens Singapore office.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's IFS Industrial opens Singapore office.

text.p: Sweden's IFS Industrial and Financial Systems said on Thursday it had opened a Singapore office to meet increased interest in its integrated business solutions among Asian companies.
The company said in a statement it would expand its presence in Asia through increased investment, more strategic alliances and by placing continued emphasis on research and development.
It said the acquisition of U.S. software firm Avalon Software last September had allowed the extension of its distribution network.
